name: Mitani Ryouko
source: [url=/c12077]Ayumu's[/url] mother and [url=/c10479]Rikuto's[/url] stepmother. Her maiden name is Tsunoda (角田). She is very sensitive about her age. For some reason, she has forced Ayumu to dress and act like a boy.
